thesis.title: Intelligent Sign Language Recognition & Braille Representation
bullets: Developed a multimodal deep learning framework combining EfficientNet-B0, ViT, and GCNs for sign recognition.
Implemented a Cross-Modal Attention Fusion mechanism, achieving 91.27% accuracy and 0.9125 Macro F1-score.
Generated Bangladeshi Braille Unicode from recognized signs to support accessible communication.

projects.name: AgriNetwork
projects.subtitle: P2P Agricultural Marketplace & Live Bidding Engine
projects.description: A full-stack peer-to-peer agricultural marketplace facilitating direct transactions between farmers and consumers, featuring real-time bidding, interactive live video streaming, and automated KYC verification.
bullets: Developed a full-stack peer-to-peer agricultural marketplace facilitating direct transactions between farmers and consumers.
Implemented real-time interactive product live streaming paired with a dynamic live-bidding system using Socket.io and WebRTC protocols.
Integrated automated KYC (Know Your Customer) verification workflows to authenticate platform users and secure backend transactional pipelines.

projects.name: PlantPulse
projects.subtitle: Plant Care Platform & E-Commerce Marketplace
projects.description: A full-stack plant wellness ecosystem and e-commerce marketplace featuring automated daily care routines, schedule evaluation, dynamic reminders, and a secure checkout pipeline.
bullets: Developed a full-stack plant wellness platform and e-commerce marketplace using React, Express.js, and MongoDB Atlas.
Implemented automated plant care tracking using Node-Cron to evaluate schedules daily and trigger dynamic watering, pruning, and fertilizing reminders.
Built an e-commerce checkout pipeline with cart state management, product catalog, and secure user authentication via Firebase and JWT.

projects.name: Multimodal Musical Context Analysis
projects.subtitle: Graph Neural Networks & NLP for Audio Semantics
projects.description: A multimodal deep learning system combining Graph Neural Networks (GNN) and BERT embeddings to model musical context from acoustic audio features and semantic textual metadata.
bullets: Developed a hybrid BERT and Graph Neural Network (GNN) pipeline to model musical context from audio features and semantic metadata.
Processed audio into temporal segments, extracted features, and constructed segment-based graphs to represent temporal structure and feature similarity.
Integrated BERT-based semantic representations from song descriptions, tags, and metadata with graph-based music representations for multimodal context analysis.

projects.name: Credit Card Fraud Detection with XAI
projects.subtitle: Imbalanced Stream Analytics & Explainable AI Audits
projects.description: An end-to-end fraud detection pipeline across 568K+ transactions simulating realistic 99:1 imbalanced transaction streams, calibrated via PR thresholds and made auditable with SHAP and LIME.
bullets: Developed an end-to-end fraud detection pipeline benchmarking Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and a custom PyTorch DNN across 568K+ transactions with Robust Scaling and PCA.
Simulated a realistic 99:1 imbalanced transaction stream and implemented algorithmic Precision-Recall threshold calibration, improving model precision from 0.48 to 0.86 and F1-score to 0.90.
Integrated Explainable AI (XAI) using SHAP for global feature importance and LIME for local instance audits to make neural network decisions transparent and auditable.

projects.name: 3D Fishing Game
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Computer Graphics Simulation & Physics Engine
projects.description: An interactive 3D simulation game utilizing Python and PyOpenGL for real-time computer graphics rendering, custom coordinate transformations, view projections, and bounding-box collision detection.
bullets: Developed an interactive 3D simulation game utilizing Python and PyOpenGL for real-time computer graphics rendering.
Implemented custom 3D coordinate transformations, view projections, and bounding-box collision detection algorithms for real-time game physics.
Designed responsive keyboard and mouse event-handling mechanics to handle user controls, hook mechanics, and state-driven environment interactions.
